facts.fact: ATPE reports that the Finance minister met on 17 February 2026 the payment establishments and services in Chad, named as Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi Tchad, on mobile money for state flows; it does not state the licensing basis.
facts.system: Payment establishments in Chad (Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom, Cashi Tchad)
